title: How to tell if a startup has a moat
author: Dan Hockenmaier
description: A framework for assessing whether the company you’re considering joining is built to last
summary: Each week, I share deeply researched product, growth, and career advice. For more: Lenny’s Jobs | Lenny’s Podcast | Lennybot | How I AI | Become an AI-Native Builder and my other favorite AI/PM courses .

Not only can startups be a great learning experience and a lot of fun, but they can also provide economic rewards comparable to (or greater than) the “safe” route into big tech.
However, for this to be true, you must rigorously evaluate the startup you’re considering joining.
